summary.text: Tom Mehaffie is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2016, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 106, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mehaffie's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session, as listed by Ballotpedia, were Aging & Older Adult Services, Game & Fisheries, and Urban Affairs & Housing.
In the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions he was vice chair of the Gaming Oversight Committee.
